title: "L01: Antineoplastic agents"
description: "ATC L01 antineoplastic agents for modelers: toxicity sets the dose, not efficacy; efficacy is modeled in two steps; antibodies are nonlinear where it matters."
date: "2026-02-08"
---

Part of [L: Antineoplastic and immunomodulating agents](../).

**Toxicity sets the dose, not efficacy.**
Dose-limiting toxicity is a binary readout in a short early window [@letourneau2009dose; @yin2024handling].
For cytotoxics, neutropenia is the continuous alternative, captured by semi-mechanistic myelosuppression models with a proliferating compartment, maturation transit compartments and a feedback term [@friberg2002myelo; @camaradesouza2018transit].

**Efficacy is modeled in two steps.**
A longitudinal tumor size model (RECIST sum of diameters) balances drug-driven shrinkage against regrowth [@ribba2014review; @stein2008tumor]; quantities derived from it feed a [time-to-event](/docs/modeling/tte/) analysis of survival [@claret2014tgimetrics; @bruno2014evaluation].
That is what lets early imaging inform an endpoint reading out much later [@claret2009phase3os; @chan2021tgios].

**Antibodies are nonlinear where it matters.**
Target-mediated drug disposition makes binding itself an elimination pathway that saturates [@mager2001tmdd; @dua2015tmddtutorial], so a model fitted only to the top of the dose range will mislead at the bottom [@gibiansky2008tmddapprox].
Antibody-drug conjugates add conjugate, total antibody and payload as separate analytes [@li2020adcquant; @khan2025adcbioanalysis].

**Cell therapies replace PK with cellular kinetics.**
A living product expands, contracts and persists [@liu2021carkinetics; @stein2019tisacell], and the administered dose is a weak predictor of the exposure that follows [@he2022cartdosing].

**Covariates carrying dosing guidance.**
DPYD for fluoropyrimidines, TPMT and NUDT15 for thiopurines, UGT1A1 for irinotecan, CYP2D6 for tamoxifen [@kicken2025precision; @chatelut2018smki].

## CAR T cell therapy

![](https://pub.mdpi-res.com/pharmaceutics/pharmaceutics-14-01630/article_deploy/html/images/pharmaceutics-14-01630-g001.png?1659607210)

Emily Whitehead, the first child treated with CD19-directed CAR T cells for refractory acute lymphoblastic leukemia, entered a durable complete remission [@grupp2013carall].
